_comment: run_55e = 51a with RELATIVE Allee (mate-finding by N/K) pinned at V&L's own ratio n50/K = 0.0197: no unit bridge needed, and a small K cannot by itself make a cell Allee-dead (the principled form of a K floor: if birds occupy the suitable patches whose area K reflects, local density scales with N/K).

V&L 1996 p. 263: r = 0.15 birds/km2 at K* ~3.8/km2 (4% unmated at K*/2), chosen from r 0.05/0.15/0.25 by spread rate -> half of breeders mated at N = r/2 = 0.075/km2 = 0.0197 K*; mapped through our capacity level (median 3.0 route counts).

Why (user, 2026-10-18): Allee effects are unidentifiable from count data -- pin to literature like dispersal, sensitivity around it. Every free refine raised n50 3-9x and used it with low K as an absence switch (Allee-dead 18-27%).
